personality_one_liner: An elegant, corporate, and highly trustworthy CRM that balances dual professional roles with flawless clarity and iOS-native comfort.

spacing.rule: Generous padding around content. Avoid dense dashboards unless absolutely necessary. Use iOS-native spacing rhythms.

screens.name: Login
screens.purpose: Secure entry via email or Google with a premium corporate aesthetic.
screens.layout: Hero image at the top (abstract slate/blue background) overlaid with a subtle gradient scrim. Bottom half contains a clean, single-column form on surfaceSecondary. Email, Password, and 'Accedi con Google' button.

screens.name: Dashboard (Home)
screens.purpose: Dual-area quick stats overview and daily callbacks.

states.empty: Illustration of a planner with a message to start adding appointments.
states.error: Error loading dashboard data with a retry button.

screens.layout: Sticky glass header. Two main summary cards side-by-side using a grid (flexWrap, space-between). One card accented with energy_red, the other with networker_blue. Below, a scrollable list of 'Da Richiamare Oggi' (Callbacks) grouped by area, with distinct colored dot indicators.

screens.name: Contatti (Contacts)
screens.purpose: Manage clients with personal/referral tags and area assignment.

states.empty: Empty desk/clipboard photo with 'Nessun contatto trovato'.

screens.layout: Sticky header with search bar and filter chips (Tutti, Energia, Network). Vertical list of contacts with minimum 56pt tappable height. Avatar (initials), Name, Tag (Conoscenza/Referenza), and Area indicator.

screens.name: Dettaglio Contatto (Contact Detail)
screens.purpose: Deep dive into a contact, offering text/voice notes, files, and Waze link.
screens.layout: Cover image (abstract blue) with gradient scrim and initials avatar overlapping. Tabbed or segmented control layout below: Info (Address with Waze icon), Note (Text/Voice), File (PDF/JPG list). Floating action button to add a note or file.

screens.name: Calendario
screens.purpose: Shared appointment view color-coded by area with quick actions.

states.empty: Empty state illustration of a planner.

screens.layout: Weekly/Monthly calendar strip at the top. Scrollable vertical list of appointments below. Each card has a thick left border (red for Energy, blue for Network), a phone icon if it's a call, and a 'Fatto' (Done) checkbox. Tapping opens the post-meeting checklist.

screens.name: Report
screens.purpose: Analytics for both areas across multiple timeframes.
screens.layout: Segmented control at the top (Giorno, Settimana, Mese, Anno). Two distinct sections (or toggleable via tabs): Consulenza Energetica (Red accents) and Network (Blue accents). Large typography for key metrics (Appuntamenti, Contratti, Prodotti).

empty_dashboard.alt: Open planner with pen on a glass desk

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the 'iOS-Native Clean' personality guidelines. Use generous spacing (md/lg), rounded corners (md:12), and subtle shadow (tier 1).

Implement a clear dual-identity UI. Use 'energy_red' (#C83232) for Consulente Energetico elements and 'networker_blue' (#1B6CB0) for Networker elements. These should be used as accents (left borders on cards, dot indicators, tags) on top of the clean white/slate base.
The UI text MUST be in Italian as requested in the problem statement (e.g., 'Contatti', 'Calendario', 'Appuntamenti', 'Fatto').
Ensure every screen with a primary action has a sticky CTA at the bottom over scrolling content, wrapped in a glassmorphism container.
For the Contact Detail screen, incorporate a segmented control to switch between 'Note', 'File', and 'Info'. Ensure the Waze integration is prominent in the Info tab.

Post-meeting checklists are specific to the area. For Energy: 'Non interessato', 'Contratto fatto', 'Richiamare'. For Networker: 'Post appuntamento', 'Ok abo', 'Ok cliente', 'Dare seguito', 'Primo avvio', 'Presentazione prodotti', 'Incontro open', 'Incontro BBS', 'Incontro WES'. Use native-feeling bottom sheets or modals for these checklists.
All images used as backgrounds MUST include a vertical gradient scrim (transparent to surfaceInverse) to guarantee text readability.
Do NOT use any emojis in the UI. Use Ionicons filled/outlined icons appropriately.
